text:
Harper (CSM): Heads up — Altana Labs shows a sharp drop in daily active seats since last Wed, ~43% WoW. Saw it in the dashboard: https://redwood.app/altana/usage :eyes:
Maya (CS): OMG that's a big swing. Any known outages or billing issues?
Harper (CSM): No outages. Support tickets are low. Billing looks normal.
Harper (CSM): Noticed a stakeholder change — their PM (champion) left mid-demo last week.
Liam (AE): I had a brief touchpoint yesterday. They mentioned evaluating EchoServe for cost and latency.
Maya (CS): EchoServe? ok. Do we know which workflows they're replacing?
Liam (AE): Mostly internal triage and report generation. They said EchoServe is cheaper per-1000 tokens in their pilot.
Anika (RevOps): Can we get a quick unit-cost comparison for their current workload? I can run numbers if you drop token distribution.
Harper (CSM): Dropping CSV now with sample prompt mix.
Eva (Support): I can check recent error rates and slow queries — nothing out of the ordinary in logs.
OpsBot: Incident alert cleared: no infra anomalies for Altana Labs in the past 72h.
Maya (CS): Ok — next steps: 1) Schedule a renewal-risk sync with their new PM + procurement. 2) Offer a 30-day performance-focused pilot (dedicated route) to show latency/cost delta. 3) Prep tailored cost calc and a short enablement workshop.
Liam (AE): I'll request a meeting. Can someone draft the cost comparison + suggested pilot terms?
Anika (RevOps): I'll assemble cost + 1-page ROI. Need average token lengths and session counts (Harper's CSV should help).
Harper (CSM): Uploaded CSV to the shared folder and tagged you all.
Maya (CS): I'll lead the enablement 45-min workshop: topics = routing policies, prefix caching, and batching knobs.
Liam (AE): Also proposing a limited canary: dedicated small pool + fallback to hosted if capacity spikes. That shows reliability advantage vs EchoServe.
Harper (CSM): Good. Tentative timeline: discovery call tomorrow, cost deck by EOD Thu, workshop next Wed.
Liam (AE): I'll ping their procurement and cc @Anika.
Eva (Support): If they opt-in for the pilot, I'll attach a high-touch onboarding checklist and SLA notes.
Maya (CS): Can we also get a sample prompt evaluation set to measure quality regressions vs EchoServe? Even a short eval helps retention.
Harper (CSM): Agreed. I'll extract 20 representative prompts from their CSV and share.
Anika (RevOps): Marking renewal-risk = medium-high. Updating CRM forecast (will attach notes).
Harper (CSM): Thanks all. If we can tighten the cost narrative and run the workshop, we should be able to win the pilot and re-engage seats. :crossed_fingers:
Liam (AE): On it. Will report back after discovery.
Harper (CSM): Closing loop here — will post meeting notes and next actions in this thread after the discovery call.
